verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Sentry retention-period settings, data deletion controls, or purge APIs. The closest item, `include_prompts=False`, stops AI content from being collected in the first place. That is an adjacent data-minimization control, not control over how long stored data is kept or how it is deleted. Community reports of self-hosting describe a deployment choice, not a documented retention or deletion feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
